↳ Posted by jasbas on February 17th, 2009.

Yes, a very good transcription. I play this in G, rather than F. It’s a bit more English-concertina friendly for myself and other trad musicians should find G very acceptable. Also G isn’t too far away from Sharon’s original key, so it retains the character, I think.
